meta.source: TShockAPI/Commands.cs (核心指令, best-effort 解析) + i18n/zh_CN/TShockAPI.po
meta.note: 插件指令和运行时别名不在此文件中，实际可用指令以目标服务器为准
meta.paramNote: paramSets 为 best-effort：仅来自 TShock 源码里可信的用法串/枚举常量或方法体不引用 args.Parameters 的机械判定；没有 paramSets 的指令请自由输入

commands.name: setup
commands.help: Used to authenticate as superadmin when first setting up TShock.
commands.helpEn: Used to authenticate as superadmin when first setting up TShock.
commands.helpZh: 首次设置 TShock时用作超级管理员身份验证。

commands.name: logout
commands.help: Logs you out of your current account.
commands.helpEn: Logs you out of your current account.

commands.name: broadcast
commands.help: Broadcasts a message to everyone on the server.
commands.helpEn: Broadcasts a message to everyone on the server.
commands.helpZh: 向所有在线玩家广播一条消息。

commands.name: displaylogs
commands.help: Toggles whether you receive server logs.
commands.helpEn: Toggles whether you receive server logs.
commands.helpZh: 开关是否接收服务器日志。

paramSets.syntax: group parent <group name> [new parent group name]

commands.name: kick
commands.help: Removes a player from the server.
commands.helpEn: Removes a player from the server.
commands.helpZh: 将一名玩家踢出服务器。

commands.name: overridessc
commands.help: Overrides serverside characters for a player, temporarily.
commands.helpEn: Overrides serverside characters for a player, temporarily.

commands.name: savessc
commands.helpZh: 保存所有玩家的服务端存档。

commands.name: uploadssc
commands.help: Upload the account information when you joined the server as your Server Side Character data.
commands.helpEn: Upload the account information when you joined the server as your Server Side Character data.
commands.helpZh: 上传并使用加入服务器时的本地存档来覆盖服务器端存档。

commands.name: su
commands.help: Temporarily elevates you to Super Admin.
commands.helpEn: Temporarily elevates you to Super Admin.
commands.helpZh: 暂时将你提升为超级管理员。

commands.name: sudo
commands.help: Executes a command as the super admin.
commands.helpEn: Executes a command as the super admin.
commands.helpZh: 以超级管理员的身份执行指令。

commands.name: annoy
commands.help: Annoys a player for an amount of time.
commands.helpEn: Annoys a player for an amount of time.
commands.helpZh: 骚扰一个玩家一段时间。

commands.name: rocket
commands.help: Rockets a player upwards. Requires SSC.
commands.helpEn: Rockets a player upwards. Requires SSC.
commands.helpZh: 把一名玩家射上天。需要启用服务端存档。

commands.name: firework
commands.helpZh: 在一个玩家身上生成烟花。

commands.name: off
commands.help: Shuts down the server while saving.
commands.helpEn: Shuts down the server while saving.

commands.name: off-nosave
commands.help: Shuts down the server without saving.
commands.helpEn: Shuts down the server without saving.
commands.helpZh: 关闭服务器但不保存数据。

commands.name: reload
commands.helpZh: 重新加载服务器配置文件。

commands.name: give
commands.helpZh: 给另一位玩家一件物品。

commands.name: butcher
commands.help: Kills hostile NPCs or NPCs of a certain type.
commands.helpEn: Kills hostile NPCs or NPCs of a certain type.
commands.helpZh: 击杀敌对NPC或者一种指定类型的NPC。

commands.name: maxspawns
commands.help: Sets the maximum number of NPCs.
commands.helpEn: Sets the maximum number of NPCs.

commands.name: spawnboss
commands.help: Spawns a number of bosses around you.
commands.helpEn: Spawns a number of bosses around you.

commands.name: spawnmob
commands.help: Spawns a number of mobs around you.
commands.helpEn: Spawns a number of mobs around you.
commands.helpZh: 在你的周围生成一些生物。

commands.name: spawnrate
commands.help: Sets the spawn rate of NPCs.
commands.helpEn: Sets the spawn rate of NPCs.

commands.name: clearangler
commands.help: Resets the list of users who have completed an angler quest that day.
commands.helpEn: Resets the list of users who have completed an angler quest that day.
commands.helpZh: 重置当天已完成渔夫任务的用户列表。

commands.name: home
commands.help: Sends you to your spawn point.
commands.helpEn: Sends you to your spawn point.
commands.helpZh: 将你传送到你的出生点。

commands.name: spawn
commands.help: Sends you to the world's spawn point.
commands.helpEn: Sends you to the world's spawn point.
commands.helpZh: 将你传送到世界的出生点。

commands.name: tp
commands.help: Teleports a player to another player.
commands.helpEn: Teleports a player to another player.
commands.helpZh: 将一个玩家传送至另一个玩家。

commands.name: tppos
commands.helpZh: 将你传送到一个图格坐标。

commands.name: pos
commands.help: Returns the user's or specified user's current position.
commands.helpEn: Returns the user's or specified user's current position.
commands.helpZh: 返回你或指定用户当前的位置。

commands.name: tpallow
commands.help: Toggles whether other people can teleport you.
commands.helpEn: Toggles whether other people can teleport you.
commands.helpZh: 是否允许他人传送至你。

commands.name: forcehalloween
commands.help: Toggles halloween mode (goodie bags, pumpkins, etc).
commands.helpEn: Toggles halloween mode (goodie bags, pumpkins, etc).
commands.helpZh: 切换万圣节模式（口袋，南瓜，等）。

commands.name: forcexmas
commands.help: Toggles christmas mode (present spawning, santa, etc).
commands.helpEn: Toggles christmas mode (present spawning, santa, etc).
commands.helpZh: 切换圣诞模式（当前生成速度，圣诞老人，等）。

commands.name: worldevent
commands.help: Enables starting and stopping various world events.
commands.helpEn: Enables starting and stopping various world events.
commands.helpZh: 允许你开始或停止各种世界事件。

commands.name: protectspawn
commands.helpZh: 启用或关闭出生点保护。

commands.name: setspawn
commands.help: Sets the world's spawn point to your location.
commands.helpEn: Sets the world's spawn point to your location.
commands.helpZh: 将世界的出生点设置为你的位置。

commands.name: setdungeon
commands.help: Sets the dungeon's position to your location.
commands.helpEn: Sets the dungeon's position to your location.
commands.helpZh: 把地牢的位置设置为你的位置。

commands.name: settle
commands.help: Forces all liquids to update immediately.
commands.helpEn: Forces all liquids to update immediately.
commands.helpZh: 立即强制更新所有液体。

commands.name: worldinfo
commands.help: Shows information about the current world.
commands.helpEn: Shows information about the current world.

commands.name: buff
commands.help: Gives yourself a buff or debuff for an amount of time. Putting -1 for time will set it to 415 days.
commands.helpEn: Gives yourself a buff or debuff for an amount of time. Putting -1 for time will set it to 415 days.
commands.helpZh: 给自己添加一段时间的Buff或Debuff。如果时间为-1会持续约415天。

commands.name: gbuff
commands.help: Gives another player a buff or debuff for an amount of time. Putting -1 for time will set it to 415 days.
commands.helpEn: Gives another player a buff or debuff for an amount of time. Putting -1 for time will set it to 415 days.
commands.helpZh: 给另一位玩家添加一段时间的Buff或Debuff。如果时间为-1会持续约415天。

commands.name: godmode
commands.helpZh: 切换一个玩家的无敌模式。

commands.name: heal
commands.help: Heals a player in HP and MP.
commands.helpEn: Heals a player in HP and MP.
commands.helpZh: 治愈玩家的血量和魔力。

commands.name: me
commands.help: Sends an action message to everyone.
commands.helpEn: Sends an action message to everyone.
commands.helpZh: 向所有人发送一个动作消息。

commands.name: party
commands.help: Sends a message to everyone on your team.
commands.helpEn: Sends a message to everyone on your team.
commands.helpZh: 向你的团队中的每个人发送一条消息。

commands.name: reply
commands.help: Replies to a PM sent to you.
commands.helpEn: Replies to a PM sent to you.

commands.name: slap
commands.helpZh: 击打一名玩家，造成伤害。

commands.name: warp
commands.help: Teleports you to a warp point or manages warps.
commands.helpEn: Teleports you to a warp point or manages warps.
commands.helpZh: 将你传送到一个传送点或者管理传送点。

commands.name: whisper
commands.help: Sends a PM to a player.
commands.helpEn: Sends a PM to a player.
commands.helpZh: 给玩家发送一条私聊消息

commands.name: wallow
commands.help: Toggles to either ignore or recieve whispers from other players.
commands.helpEn: Toggles to either ignore or recieve whispers from other players.
commands.helpZh: 开关是否接收他人的私聊。

commands.name: dump-reference-data
commands.help: Creates a reference tables for Terraria data types and the TShock permission system in the server folder.
commands.helpEn: Creates a reference tables for Terraria data types and the TShock permission system in the server folder.
commands.helpZh: 在服务器目录下生成泰拉瑞亚和TShock权限的参考信息表。

commands.name: sync
commands.help: Sends all tiles from the server to the player to resync the client with the actual world state.
commands.helpEn: Sends all tiles from the server to the player to resync the client with the actual world state.
commands.helpZh: 重新发送玩家附近的物块信息，使玩家与服务器同步当前的地图状态。

commands.name: respawn
commands.helpZh: 复活你自己或其他玩家。

commands.name: help
commands.help: Lists commands or gives help on them.
commands.helpEn: Lists commands or gives help on them.
commands.helpZh: 列出指令或显示指令的帮助信息。

commands.name: motd
commands.help: Shows the message of the day.
commands.helpEn: Shows the message of the day.

commands.name: death
commands.helpZh: 显示你的的总死亡次数。

commands.name: pvpdeath
commands.help: Shows your number of PVP deaths.
commands.helpEn: Shows your number of PVP deaths.

commands.name: alldeath
commands.help: Shows the number of deaths for all online players.
commands.helpEn: Shows the number of deaths for all online players.
commands.helpZh: 显示服务器中所有在线玩家的死亡次数。

commands.name: allpvpdeath
commands.help: Shows the number of PVP deaths for all online players.
commands.helpEn: Shows the number of PVP deaths for all online players.
commands.helpZh: 显示服务器中所有在线玩家的PvP死亡次数。
